site.title: Jules Pecaoco — Web & Mobile Developer
site.description: Jules Pecaoco builds practical web and mobile products. Explore selected work, experience, and opportunities to collaborate.
site.aboutBio:
I'm a web and mobile application developer interested in making useful things for real people.

My work spans attendance workflows, mobile applications, educational websites, and administrative tools. I enjoy bringing structure to a problem and turning it into an experience people can navigate.

I’m comfortable collaborating remotely and delivering features independently. I welcome conversations about the problem your team is trying to solve and how I can contribute.

projects.title: QR Code Attendance System
projects.summary: An attendance workflow used by an organization handling 1,600+ students.
projects.problem: Make attendance collection easier to manage for an organization serving more than 1,600 students. A QR-based workflow connects check-in activity with digital attendance records.
projects.story:
I developed a QR-based attendance system for a university department in Bacolod as a freelance developer from June to August 2025. The system supports multiple scanning stations for an organization serving more than 1,600 students.

My work included API design, database schema design, role-based access control, automated reporting, and support for concurrent use and multi-tenant access. These pieces connect check-in activity with the administrative records staff need.

The project turns attendance collection into a connected digital workflow. Explore the live application to review the experience and contact me to discuss implementation and delivery.

projects.title: TANAW
projects.summary: A mobile application for climate-risk visualization, location-based mapping, and hazard reporting.
projects.problem: Help people explore climate risks and report hazards through location-based information on mobile devices.
projects.story:
I developed TANAW during 2025 as a mobile application for climate-risk visualization using real-time geospatial data. React Native and Expo provide the mobile foundation, with Supabase supporting backend services.

My work included location-based mapping, live data updates, and a modular architecture for real-time hazard reporting and future feature expansion. AI-assisted reporting supports the organization of user-submitted incident information.

The project brings mapping, environmental information, and reporting into a connected mobile experience. Open the project or source to explore its interface and implementation.

projects.title: CyberAdryx Online
projects.summary: Cybersecurity learning content for IT students and professionals.
projects.problem: Make cybersecurity topics approachable for IT students and professionals through a dedicated educational website.
projects.story:
I built and launched CyberAdryx Online during October and November 2025 to promote digital forensics and cybersecurity awareness. React and TypeScript provide the website foundation.

My contribution included educational content covering cyber threats, security fundamentals, and system protection strategies. The website encourages proactive security practices and continued learning.

Explore the live website to review its content and interface, or inspect the repository for the current implementation.

projects.title: Healthmate
projects.summary: Health records, patient information, and ingredient-based nutrition discovery.
projects.problem: Bring patient information, health records, and ingredient-based nutrition discovery into a web application.
projects.story:
I developed HealthMate during April and May 2025 as a full-stack health records management application using PHP, MySQL, and Apache.

My work included relational database schemas for patient and medical records and an MVC-style architecture to separate responsibilities and support maintainability. The wider project also explores ingredient-based nutrition discovery.

The project connects database design with application workflows for organizing health information. Its source provides a reference for discussing record storage, backend structure, and form-based interfaces.

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.summary: A structured approach to organizing and retrieving library data.
projects.problem: Organize library information while exploring database design, querying, and application development.
projects.story:
This Python and Flask project explores data modeling, querying, encryption, and optimization. SQLAlchemy and SQLite support the database layer, with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript used for the interface.

The application connects database concepts to a record-management workflow. It provides a practical setting for examining how information is structured, retrieved, and presented.

The repository includes installation guidance and serves as the reference for running and inspecting the project.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio
projects.summary: A personal home for selected work, experience, and professional conversations.
projects.problem: Give recruiters, collaborators, and prospective clients a clear route from selected work to professional contact.
projects.story:
This portfolio brings project summaries, case studies, a CV, and contact options together. The current public site uses Astro for static pages, while a retained React administration area supports content editing.

A warm palette, expressive typography, responsive layouts, and restrained motion shape the presentation. Project pages connect the work’s purpose with screenshots and available source links.

Firebase content snapshots support a publishing workflow that separates saved drafts from published content. The static build turns a validated snapshot into public pages.

projects.title: Powerfitness
projects.summary: A gym website bringing schedules, trainers, and membership information together.
projects.problem: Help prospective gym members find classes, trainers, membership information, and a way to make contact.
projects.story:
Powerfitness organizes gym information into a responsive business website built with Bootstrap and jQuery. It brings schedules, trainer profiles, and membership highlights into a single browsing experience.

The project focuses on the information a prospective member needs before making an enquiry. Its sections connect the gym’s offering with a contact experience.

Explore the live website to review the layout and navigation across screen sizes.

projects.title: Memorial Plan Manager
projects.summary: Plan records, cost calculations, and printable receipts in a desktop workflow.
projects.problem: Bring plan records, cost calculations, and printable receipts into a single desktop workflow.
projects.story:
This Java and JavaFX application supports creating, viewing, updating, and deleting memorial plan records. MySQL provides the database layer.

Cost calculations and receipt printing sit alongside record management, connecting administrative data with the documents needed to complete the workflow.

The project demonstrates desktop interface development and database-backed operations. The source is available for a closer look at the application structure.

projects.title: Java Calculator
projects.summary: An expression calculator supporting more than basic arithmetic.
projects.problem: Interpret mathematical expressions beyond a basic two-number calculator.
projects.story:
This Java learning project handles parentheses, negative values, decimals, and exponents alongside arithmetic expressions.

Its focus is expression parsing: turning entered text into a sequence of operations that respects the structure of the expression.

The source offers a compact example for discussing parsing logic, input handling, and application behavior.
